info.title: Ax ↔ Habitat Gateway
info.description: Read status, mission results and heartbeat events; submit missions, decide approvals with an owner attestation, and run bounded recovery. Disabled unless HABITAT_GATEWAY_ENABLED=true. Every POST requires x-ax-timestamp and x-ax-nonce. A 202 means received, not executed; a completed mission is verified only when its detail reports verification evidence.

servers.description: Set this to the public HTTPS origin of the Habitat gateway before importing into ChatGPT.

bearerAuth.description: Dedicated integration token, shown once, stored hashed, revocable.

nonce.name: x-ax-nonce
nonce.description: 16-128 chars, single use within the timestamp window.

idempotency.name: Idempotency-Key
idempotency.description: Same key returns the same mission; duplicate:true.
